summary: Standards: (a) the five-minute floor is pinned only from below (fixtures 4m30s and 1m are young, 6m is stale): a floor moved to 6 or 7 minutes stays green, and a floor of 5 vs 4m31s is not told apart; `STALE_AFTER` is a constant so the risk is a later edit. (b) artifacts.prune.18 and .21 use chmod 0555/0000 and so fail (loudly, not silently) when the suite runs as root; CI is ubuntu-latest `cargo test --workspace` as a non-root runner, so they run there. Neither changes a verdict.
